name: Noclip Accuracy
description: Noclip with accuracy tracking and a death flash, plus a floating pause-menu panel with safe mode, hitboxes, FPS counter, custom FPS and game speed.

pause-menu.name: Pause Menu Panel
pause-menu.description: Show the floating, draggable Player Menu on the pause screen.

enable-noclip.name: Enable Noclip
enable-noclip.description: Prevents dying from obstacles. Turn this off if you use a separate noclip mod.

safe-mode.name: Safe Mode
safe-mode.description: Never saves progress, completions, stars or percentages. Leave this on while using noclip or a changed game speed.

show-accuracy.name: Show Accuracy
show-accuracy.description: Shows your noclip accuracy in the corner of the screen.

show-fps.name: FPS Counter
show-fps.description: Shows your current frame rate under the accuracy readout.

flash-enabled.name: Death Flash
flash-enabled.description: Flash the screen whenever you would have died.

flash-color.name: Flash Color
flash-color.description: Color and opacity of the death flash. Keep the alpha low for a subtle effect.

flash-duration.name: Flash Duration
flash-duration.description: How long the flash takes to fade out, in seconds.

flash-continuous.name: Flash Every Frame
flash-continuous.description: Re-trigger the flash on every frame you are inside a hazard, instead of once per hit.

fps-enabled.name: Custom FPS
fps-enabled.description: Run the game at the frame rate set below instead of the game's own limit.

fps-value.name: FPS
fps-value.description: Target frame rate used when Custom FPS is on.

game-speed.name: Game Speed
game-speed.description: Speed multiplier while playing a level. 1.00 is normal speed. Menus and the pause screen always run at normal speed.
